name: SWE-rebench
summary: Nebius's continuously refreshed, decontaminated SWE agent benchmark and dataset: 21,000+ validated GitHub issue-PR tasks plus a time-windowed leaderboard.
description: The Hugging Face dataset `nebius/SWE-rebench` (CC-BY-4.0; each task also carries its source repo's license) is built by an automated pipeline that extracts and validates interactive tasks from 3,400+ Python repositories, with prebuilt Docker images for thousands of tasks. The leaderboard at swe-rebench.com evaluates models and agents on fresh tasks within a selectable time window to limit contamination and reports resolved rate, pass@5, cost and tokens per problem. A SWE-rebench v2 (paper arXiv 2602.23866) is also published. Run evaluations with the MIT-licensed SWE-bench fork.
